user.title: Sign in to myAir
user.description: Use the account you sign in to the myAir app with.

data_description.region: Europe for accounts made at {eu_site}, North America for those made at {na_site}.

verify_mfa.title: Verification code
verify_mfa.description: Enter the code ResMed sent to your email.

sensors.title: Bedroom sensors
sensors.description: Optional. The temperature and humidity of the bedroom are averaged over each night's session and kept with the night.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to myAir again
reauth_confirm.description: myAir no longer accepts the login of {username}. Enter the password to sign in again.

error.invalid_auth: myAir refused the email or the password.
error.invalid_code: myAir refused the code. Check it and try again.
error.incomplete_account: The account's setup isn't finished in the myAir app, or it has no device.
error.cannot_connect: myAir couldn't be reached. Try again in a moment.

abort.already_configured: This device has already been added.
abort.wrong_account: That account belongs to a different device than this entry.

init.title: Bedroom sensors
init.description: The temperature and humidity of the bedroom are averaged over each night's session and kept with the night. A change applies to the nights to come.

import_nights.name: Import nights
import_nights.description: Adds nights kept elsewhere to the stored ones. A value already stored is never replaced.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: The entry the nights belong to.

nights.name: Nights
nights.description: A list of nights, each with its date and any of the fields a stored night has.

entry_not_loaded.message: No loaded ResMed myAir Sleep entry has that ID.
